findings.evidence: From `P' = P - Δ` and bilinearity, `g P' P' = M² - (Δ·P + P·Δ) + t`, so `Δ·P + P·Δ = M² + t - M_Y²`; then `g (Δ-ξ•P) (Δ-ξ•P) = t - ξ(M²+t-M_Y²) + ξ²M² = t(1-ξ) + ξ(M_Y² - (1-ξ)M²)`, which with `tMin_def` (Boundary.lean:`tMin`) is exactly `t = tMin + u²/(1-ξ)`. The light-cone version follows since `L.plus (deltaLost K - xiLC L K • K.p) = 0` (xiLC_def, LightCone.lean:49, with `hp`) makes `g u u = g (L.transverseProj u) (L.transverseProj u)` by `bilinForm_self_eq_two_mul_plus_mul_minus_add` (LightConeBasis.lean:280), and `L.transverseProj u = deltaLostRelativeTransverse L K` (LightCone.lean:105-108).
findings.fix: Prove the covariant statement first — e.g. `theorem tMom_eq_tMin_add' (g : Bilin V) (K : DisKinematics V) {M MY ξ : ℝ} (hM : g K.p K.p = M^2) (hMY : MY2 g K = MY^2) (hξ : ξ ≠ 1) : tMom g K = tMin M MY ξ + g (deltaLost K - ξ • K.p) (deltaLost K - ξ • K.p) / (1 - ξ)` — and derive the present light-cone version from it, together with the bound and the equality criterion; keep the light-cone forms as the corollaries used by `setOf_tMom_eq_Iic_tMin`.
findings.issue: `tMom_eq_tMin_add` assumes `hg : g.IsRefl`, a `LightConeBasis L` and `hp : L.plus K.p ≠ 0` for an identity that needs none of them: for any bilinear `g`, any real `ξ ≠ 1`, `g P P = M²` and `g P' P' = M_Y²`, bilinearity alone gives `t = tMin M M_Y ξ + g (Δ - ξ•P) (Δ - ξ•P) / (1 - ξ)`. The same over-assumption propagates to `tMom_le_tMin` (line 101), `tMom_eq_tMin_iff` (line 112) and `tMom_nonpos` (line 126), whose covariant forms need only `ξ < 1` (resp. `ξ ≠ 1`) plus `g (Δ - ξ•P) (Δ - ξ•P) ≤ 0`.

findings.evidence: `tZero M (-1) = -4 * (-1)^2 * M^2 / (1 - (-1)^2) = -4M^2/0 = 0` (GPD/Kinematics.lean:87 `tZero_def`), while `2 * (-1) / (1 + (-1)) = -2/0 = 0` and `tMinElastic M 0 = 0` (Boundary.lean `tMinElastic_xiLC_zero`). This also matches the PR's own practice of stating the junk-value cases unconditionally (`le_tMin_iff`, `neg_tMin`).
findings.fix: Drop `hη` and open the proof with `by_cases h : η = -1`, closing that branch by `norm_num [Particles.Parton.GPD.tZero_def]` (both sides reduce to `0`); keep the current argument for `η ≠ -1`.
findings.issue: `tZero_eq_tMinElastic` assumes `hη : η ≠ -1`, but the statement is true at `η = -1` as well, so the hypothesis only restricts the lemma.

summary: The core identity `tMom_eq_tMin_add` and its corollaries are stated with a light-cone basis, reflexivity and `P⁺ ≠ 0` for a fact that holds for an arbitrary bilinear form and arbitrary `ξ ≠ 1`; and `tZero_eq_tMinElastic` carries a hypothesis that is not needed. Otherwise the tMin/tMinElastic layering (general first, elastic derived) is at the right level.
